<PAGE><|det|>header [114, 92, 380, 113]<|/det|>Bug ID #3 [Acknowledged]
<|det|>title [112, 148, 884, 194]<|/det|>claimCompAndConvertTo() swap with 'deadline: block.timestamp' offers no protection
<|det|>title [113, 234, 260, 251]<|/det|>Vulnerability Type
<|det|>text [114, 253, 262, 269]<|/det|>Incorrect Deadline
<|det|>title [113, 292, 185, 308]<|/det|>Severity
<|det|>text [114, 311, 180, 325]<|/det|>Medium
<|det|>title [113, 350, 212, 366]<|/det|>Description
<|det|>text [112, 368, 884, 424]<|/det|>Using block.timestamp as deadline parameter in claimCompAndConvertTo() during interaction with router, which suggests that whenever the miner decides to include the transaction in a block, it will be valid at that time, since block.timestamp will be the current timestamp.
<|det|>text [112, 426, 884, 462]<|/det|>Whichever block the txn will be included in will be block.timestamp, so setting the deadline to block.timestamp offers no protection as validators can hold the transaction indefinitely.
<|det|>title [113, 483, 236, 498]<|/det|>Affected Code
<|det|>text [142, 502, 880, 539]<|/det|>- https://github.com/hemilabs/vusd-stablecoin/blob/54f9f235f26df813152b3d3235e7f4373c e473b6/contracts/Treasury.sol#L183
<|det|>title [113, 560, 182, 575]<|/det|>Impacts
<|det|>text [112, 579, 885, 690]<|/det|>It may be more profitable for a miner to deny the transaction from being mined until the transaction incurs the maximum amount of slippage. A malicious miner can hold the transaction as the deadline is set to block.timestamp, which means that whenever the miner decides to include the transaction in a block, it will be valid at that time, since block.timestamp will be the current timestamp. The transaction might be left hanging in the mempool and be executed way later than the user wanted.
<|det|>title [113, 713, 219, 727]<|/det|>Remediation
<|det|>text [112, 732, 884, 768]<|/det|>It is recommended to add a deadline argument to the claimCompAndConvertTo() function that interacts with the router, and pass it along to the router calls.
<|det|>title [113, 790, 172, 805]<|/det|>Retest
<|det|>text [112, 809, 763, 825]<|/det|>Client's comment: will fix it in future when we have plan to update treasury contract.
